title: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails at base on this host — the fixture's negative control cannot fire
body: internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go:38 fails on this host both at the base commit 00500c24 and with this tick's changes ('a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing'). The host's git does not start `maintenance run --auto` on a plain fetch, so the armed-repository control never fires and the fixture proves nothing. Pre-existing and unrelated to wj6; it will fail any full (non-short) gate run on this host.
